title: Why You Get Chills From Certain Music
hook: Certain music can give you sudden shivers down your spine.

narration.text: Certain music can give you sudden shivers down your spine.
This feeling is called 'frisson', a French word for aesthetic chills.
Your brain releases dopamine, a pleasure chemical, in anticipation of a peak.
It is your body reacting to moments of intense emotional beauty or suspense.
This often happens with unexpected musical changes or soaring vocals.
It means the music is deeply engaging your emotional system.
Does this happen to you? Comment your go-to song for chills, like this if it surprised you, and subscribe for more insights.

description: Ever wondered why some music makes you feel a shiver? It is your brain releasing dopamine in anticipation of emotional intensity. Discover the fascinating reason behind 'frisson' and how music deeply affects your emotions.
topic: Why you might feel a shiver down your spine when listening to certain music. This is your body reacting to emotional intensity.
